scientific_scope_status: The acquired working argument gives a finite-K lower operator with the harmonic critical coefficient for real PSD hopping with one uniform zero mode and known positive gap/norm. All four number-conserving quadratures and the common-position correction are retained; it does not insert a free oscillator or assume small depletion.
